name: MyScanVR
summary:
See beyond the flat image. Explore CT and MRI scans in immersive 3D on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S.

Ask your radiology department for your CT or MRI scans in DICOM format, copy them to a USB-C drive using your computer, and plug the drive into your headset.

EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE
- Rotate, enlarge, and reposition scans with Quest controllers
- Cut away the front or move closer to look inside
- Adjust opacity, viewing range, image quality, and optional color
- Save viewing settings and reopen imported scan
